profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Bloomberg
profile.summary:
I'm a Software Engineer who has a passion for building quality software, a lifelong learner, and loves working on a product from end to end. As a marketing graduate, I somehow found myself working in the Finance industry at one of the world's most successful investment management companies. It was there that I discovered my passion for coding, as I found myself always trying to find ways to automate processes that my team was working on. Whether it was optimizing SQL queries in one of our databases, or finding some way to more efficiently use an Excel sheet's access to one of Bloomberg's REST API, I was always looking for ways to make our lives easier through software.

Naturally, I turned to learning Python, and later Javascript, building web applications in my spare time to further satisfy my interest in technology. As a former jazz musician, software allows me to satisfy my need for creativity, finding strong communities, and lifelong learning, while also giving me the ability to improve people's lives on a large scale. Visit my Github page in the Featured Section below, to see some of the applications I've built and to keep up with what's to come!


_______________________________________
Languages and Technologies I'm currently working with: Python, Flask, Javascript, React, SQL, AWS, Elasticsearch, PostgresQL

positions.title: Fund Financial Associate
positions.description:
• Led cross-team initiative to rework the derivatives pricing process and SQL database to handle reformatting of contract symbols for 80 of Vanguard’s contracts held across 50 domestic funds and ETFs
• Optimized Excel sheet on department’s shared Bloomberg terminal resulting in a 90% decrease in hits to the Bloomberg API during the derivatives pricing process, enabling other teams to use more of the department’s provisioned capacity
• Created and presented fair-value pricing reports for Vanguard’s 70 domestic equity mutual funds and ETFs to senior leadership monthly
• Automated process of researching options prices by pulling prices from Reuter’s API through an Excel extension. Resulted in a 5% decrease in nightly pricing process time
• Led weekly, cross-site metrics meetings to identify and discuss issues in the prior week’s nightly pricing processes
• Maintained and updated documentation for the derivatives pricing process to enforce best practices and increase ease of learning for new and current team members
• Communicated with outside vendors to resolve pricing discrepancies in fixed income securities discovered during our bi-monthly vendor QA checks
• Created monthly reports and analyzed delivery times of domestic and international equity prices by outside vendors in order to identify instances of late deliveries 
• Coordinated with project managers to perform remote, manual testing of the teams’ new pricing software
• Responsible for pricing over $10,000,000 of equity holdings and $5,000,000 of mortgage-backed securities held across 70 funds and ETFs daily

positions.title: Operations Associate
positions.description:
• Led a QA team of 6 people to audit the department’s AI software and ensure that it correctly closed out finalized asset transfer requests in the system
• Led training of 24 people across two teams in order to tackle a backlog of 1,000 asset transfer requests in the system. Resulted in the backlog being reduced to 70 requests within one week
• Engaged with multiple stakeholders, both upstream and downstream, processing $500,000 of incoming asset transfer requests daily
• Maintained a standard of 99% quality in QA audits for one year of processing transfer requests
• Selected to be 1 of 8 people in our 140 person cohort to process foreign transfer requests
• Created new documentation for NON-ACAT transfers (a type of transfer done via mail) in order to standardize processing of requests and ensure best practices

positions.title: Branding + Marketing Intern
positions.description:
•	Developed brand awareness through making connections with various organizations/businesses within the Southern NJ-Pennsylvania region.
•	Spearheaded the project for planning the company’s first fundraiser. 
•	Researched international grants in the areas of agriculture, water, and education.
•	Designed graphics and promotional materials for fundraiser.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
•	Assisted the teachers during music classes by demonstrating concepts on saxophone
•	Gave private lesson to one student per shift assisting with music from ensembles
•	Chaperoned music trip to New York City, performed and assisted with logistics of the children’s performances

positions.title: Front Store Personnel/Cashier
positions.description:
•	Helped with deliveries and restocked shelves according to item category
•	Provided excellent customer service and assistance to customers at a national pharmacy / retail chain
•	Handled up to $1,000 per shift in transactions and helped setup the layout behind the counter
